descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Learn Piano in VR!**

Connect your real keyboard to your Quest and learn piano with 36 guided lessons from beginner to advanced. Keys light up as you play.                                                

[media]

Play drums, taiko, and marimba. Our lessons teach real music skills — rhythm, melody, and timing.

[media]


**Perfect for Schools & Families**

Keep your child’s creativity growing. Fun for students, simple for teachers.


[media]

**Try it now!** 

$7.99 one-time purchase. No subscriptions.
